library.name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
library.author: Aung Moe Khine
library.sentence: Universal standalone TFT, touch, sprite, TFT_eSPI_Button, gradients, and visual GUI driver for ESP32 CYD resistive & capacitive boards and ESP32-S3 RGB capacitive boards.
library.paragraph: Bundles high-speed display and touch drivers with runtime hardware auto-probing for 2.4", 2.8", 3.2", 3.5", and 4.0" CYD resistive and capacitive boards (ILI9341, ST7789, ST7796, XPT2046, GT911, CST820) and ESP32-S3 parallel RGB boards (4.3", 5.0", 7.0" 800x480 ST7262 + GT911 capacitive touch). Features dual touch controller auto-detection, half-duplex SPI readback on SDA, persistent NVS hardware overrides, full TFT_eSPI and TFT_eSPI_Button drop-in compatibility, linear vertical & horizontal color gradients, alpha blending, TFT_eSprite off-screen buffering, zero-boilerplate LVGL v8/v9 integration, PlatformIO/Visual Studio support, and seamless SquareLine Studio / EEZ Studio visual GUI builder support.
